_note: Low-end CPU gate baseline (#750), read by `python -m tlwu_eval --lowend-gate` in the low-end-cpu job of .github/workflows/eval.yml (GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner, --device cpu, TLWU_CPU_THREADS=4, TLWU_HYMT_TEMP=0). latency_p*_s = per-line ASR+MT seconds over all 20 clips (nearest rank). Data: PR #787 commit f383e14, low-end-cpu job p50 2.454 / p90 3.209 s (RSS 2967 MiB) and mini-eval job p50 2.529 / p90 3.33 s; values = the higher of the two. Runner CPU types differ ~1.8x, so the job gates against the base commit run on the same runner and uses these numbers only when that run is missing. Margin (15%) and RSS cap (6 GiB) are constants in tlwu_eval/lowend.py.
